summary: You pick one specialization (African, European, Iranian, Islamic, Latin American, REEES or South Asian Studies), and every specialization also takes one globally focused core course such as COLLEGE 119. The audit checks the 28 units, the core course and each specialization's listed courses, unit floors, letter grades and language-unit caps (15 units in Iranian, Islamic and South Asian Studies, 6 in Latin American Studies, and at most 3 units of REEES Current Issues courses). Checked by hand: language proficiency where a test or an unlisted language is used, focus-of-study choices, how many units were taken on campus, and outside credit, which the subplan advisor approves. The capstones are optional.
